source_baseline: Current English, including implementation-verified local errata; no older PgBouncer snapshot is used by parity checks.
review_method: Each translation pair reviewed against current English; parameter/command semantics, conditional and negative statements, units, default values and version boundaries checked.
Changed DE/FR and JA/RU technical passages independently cross-reviewed after editing. EN/ZH facts verified against the tagged source code.
Historical changelogs checked structurally in full and semantically for changed or suspect passages; tests are not represented as a sentence-by-sentence semantic proof.
Original program diagnostics are protected verbatim; only Markdown escapes/line wrapping are normalized.
Chinese prose heading IDs retain the established localized scheme; internal links and fragments are checked in the build.
